name: jmrb-cv-tools
description: Generates the plain-LaTeX and Word versions of the resume and CV from YAML content files

scripts.build:resume: node build.js ../content/resume.yaml && cd .. && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode RuedaBecerrilJM-resume-plain.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode RuedaBecerrilJM-resume.tex
scripts.build:cv: node build.js ../content/cv.yaml && cd .. && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode RuedaBecerrilJM-CV-plain.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode RuedaBecerrilJM-CV.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode RuedaBecerrilJM-CV.tex
scripts.build: npm run build:resume && npm run build:cv
